evidence_items.quote: The Commission, assisted by the Energy Union Committee referred to in point (b) of Article 44(1), shall adopt implementing acts to set out the structure, format, technical details and process for the information referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, including a methodology for the reporting on the phasing out of energy subsidies, in particular for fossil fuels, pursuant to point (d) of Article 25

interpretive_note: Full replacement text of the first subparagraph of Article 17(4) of Regulation (EU) 2018/1999, given directly. The Commission (R) adopts binding implementing acts setting the reporting standard that Member States (T, reconstructed from 'the information referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article', i.e. Member States' progress-report content under Article 17) must follow, and does so 'assisted by' the Energy Union Committee (I) - a formally named comitology body distinct from both the Commission and individual Member States as regulatory addressees, performing a genuine mediating function in shaping the standard before it applies to Member States. Confidence is medium: (i) T is reconstructed via cross-reference to Article 17(1)-(2) rather than restated verbatim, and (ii) the Committee, while institutionally distinct, is itself composed of Member State representatives, which is a genuine point of interpretive tension about how 'distinct' the intermediary truly is from the target class.
notes: This is treated as a positive R-I-T relation because the Committee's institutional/procedural function (comitology assistance in Commission rule-making) is analytically separate from Member States' role as reporting entities, even though its members are drawn from Member States.

evidence_items.quote: '(b) the progress made by each Member State towards meeting its objectives, including progress towards the Union's climate-neutrality objective set out in Article 2(1) of Regulation (EU) 2021/1119, targets and contributions and implementing the policies and measures set out in its integrated national energy and climate plan;'

interpretive_note: Bare noun-phrase content item describing one element of the Commission's periodic Article 29(1) assessment report (part of the same Commission assessment/State-of-the-Energy-Union architecture referenced at recital 36 and Article 6(1) of this Act). It is not itself a subject-verb clause naming an acting party, so it is treated as a component of the Commission-Member-State assessment relation already coded elsewhere (Article 6(1), Article 7(1)), not a separate unit.

direct_regulator.label: European Commission
direct_regulator.role: submits the periodic review report on Regulation (EU) 2018/1999's operation

action: report to the European Parliament and Council on the operation of Regulation (EU) 2018/1999 and progress towards climate/energy targets
may accompany the report with legislative proposals
object: review report on the operation of Regulation (EU) 2018/1999

evidence_items.quote: The Commission shall report to the European Parliament and to the Council within six months of each global stocktake agreed under Article 14 of the Paris Agreement on the operation of this Regulation, its contribution to governance of the Energy Union, its contribution to the long-term goals of the Paris Agreement, progress towards the achievement of the 2030 climate and energy targets and the Union's climate-neutrality objective ..., additional Energy Union objectives and the conformity of the planning, reporting and monitoring provisions ... The Commission reports may be accompanied by legislative proposals where appropriate

interpretive_note: Full replacement text of Article 45 of Regulation (EU) 2018/1999, given directly. Self-executing Commission reporting duty to the European Parliament and Council (recipients, not targets of a compliance obligation). Substantively parallel to Article 11 of this Act (CAND2-3E6642A72EB3).

evidence_items.location: Article 13, point (11) [amending Annex VI, point (c)(viii) of Regulation (EU) 2018/1999]
evidence_items.quote: '(viii) an assessment of the contribution of the policy or measure to the achievement of the Union's climate-neutrality objective set out in Article 2(1) of Regulation (EU) 2021/1119 and to the achievement of the long-term strategy referred to in Article 15 of this Regulation;'

interpretive_note: Bare noun-phrase content item within a technical annex (Annex VI) specifying one required element of a policy/measure assessment methodology under Regulation (EU) 2018/1999. No actor performing an action is named in the text provided; the surrounding methodological provision (who conducts the assessment, for whom) is not given in this excerpt and is not imported from the external act.
